purpose: DEC-054 golden for V2-M6a (DEC-068): the review checklist of a synthetic company's 2026 framework year, with 2025 as the comparative. Every one of the nine controls raises at least one flag; the expected flags and their figures were written by hand before the code, followed by a response flow (explain, sign off by a second person, an explanation lapsing when the figures change, a reopen).
disclaimer: SYNTHETIC. The review settings are test choices of a firm, not legal values. The company, people and amounts are test choices.

openingBalance.description: Opening balances: unexplained difference held in suspense

journals.description: Travel paid personally by Jordan Director
Other income refunded against other debtors

workings.balances2026: Bank 1200: 2025 20,000 - 6,000 = 14,000; 2026 + 30,000 - 6,500 - 2,000 = 35,500. Director 2230: debit 2,000 then credit 1,200, so 800 debit (overdrawn). 1110 other debtors: credit 150. 9999 suspense: debit 300 since the opening balances. 1100 trade debtors 2,400 (the invoice); 2100 trade creditors 1,200 (both bills); 2110 accruals 800.
workings.rc01: Manual journals of the year: TRAVEL 1,200 (>= 1,000, raised), FEES 800 and REFUND 150 (below). The opening balance journal is in 2025.
workings.rc02: Lines with accounts or the retained profit, 2026 against 2025, raised when the change is at least 5,000 and at least 20% of a non-zero comparative. P.T 32,400 (30,000 cash + 2,400 invoice) against 20,000: +12,400, 62%. P.OI -150 against 0: below 5,000. P.OC 9,700 (6,500 + 1,200 + 800 + 900 + 300) against 6,000: +3,700, below. B.CA 38,050 (35,500 + 2,400 - 150 + 300) against 14,300 (14,000 + 300): +23,750, 166.08%. B.CW 400 (1,200 - 800) against 0: below. B.ACCR 800: below. B.SC 300 both years. B.PLR 36,550 (14,000 + 22,550) against 14,000: +22,550, 161.07%. Totals are not raised: their parts are.
workings.rc03: 4100 other income nets 150 debit for the year: income on the wrong side, -150.00 on its natural (credit) side.
workings.rc04: At 31.12.2026: 1110 (asset) is in credit, -150.00 on its natural side; 2230 (liability) is in debit, -800.00. Accumulated depreciation accounts are left out (their natural balance is credit).
workings.rc05: At 31.12.2026: the invoice due 31.8.2026 is 122 days overdue (over 90), 2,400; bill A due 30.9.2026 is 92 days overdue (over 90), 900; bill B due 15.12.2026 is 16 days overdue (1-30), below 60 days.
workings.rc06: The loan account on 2230 was 2,000 overdrawn from 15.2.2026 and 800 overdrawn from 31.7.2026 to the year end: overdrawn at the end and in the period, 320 days (15 February to 31 December). The firm's loan thresholds are not set, so the large-movement checks are not evaluated (V2-M4).
workings.rc07: Suspense 9999 holds 300 at the year end.
workings.rc08: The bank ledger account 1200 holds 35,500 and no bank account is set up for it, so it cannot have been reconciled. 1210 and 1220 hold nothing.
workings.rc09: Of at least 500 in the year: TRAVEL journal 1,200 (no evidence), FEES journal 800 (evidence linked: not raised), bill A 900 (no evidence), cash payments ADVANCE 2,000 and RENT26 6,500 (no evidence). Bill B 300 and REFUND 150 are below 500; receipts are not checked.
